$comment: v1 -> v2 replaced `uses-services` (plus the separate component `storage` block) with a single `services` list, and dropped the v0 boolean `publish-on-web: true` on a component. A v1 file declares `schema-version: 1` (or nothing at all, which the gate rejects); no production file is in this shape today, but the migration still exists so its schema must too.

uses-services.description: Legacy v1 field — should be migrated to services.

storage.description: Legacy v1 field — should be migrated to services.

publish-on-web.comment: v0 shape, deleted by _fixup_v2_data. It lived in the latest schema until RC-32 because git_monitor validates a file straight from git BEFORE any migration runs; now that the gate validates against the declared version, only a file that declares v1 may still carry it. Not a service contract: that lives in the service's config_model.

uses-services.description: Legacy v1 field - migrated into services by _merge_uses_services_into_services.
